title: 第2173章 旗杆三日游第2172章 上当的希伯来
content_zh:
兜兜转转，四人来到南区港口。
现在瞭望台处，俯瞰下方海域来往海船，有不下千艘，且每一艘都满载着货物。
“这么多船？”
“确实挺多的。”希伯来点头说道。
“我说这里为什么会有这么多船来这里。”维林转头看着希伯来，有些无奈的说道。
“因为有利可图，所以这些人就做来了啊。”希伯来眨了眨眼睛，脸上露出无辜的表情。
见这小子还是没有明白自己话里的含义后，维林十分直白的询问道：“你小子就跟我好好讲一讲这里商业繁荣的起因，又是谁打下的基础，现在已经达到了什么规模。”
“我还以为主上你准备借着这个缘由夸我一番。”希伯来摸了摸后脑勺，略微有些尴尬的说道。
维林狠狠地瞪了希伯来一眼后，让他赶紧说。
要不是知道这小子心思单纯，他还以为是因为自己没收了这小子的书，他在这里装傻气自己。
“这其实都是大哥的功劳。”希伯来见状，不敢废话，乖乖解释道，“因为传送阵第五个中转站是海纳斯人鱼王国，所以大哥就专门开通了一条渠道，由我们的人携带空间装备作为中间人帮这些商人转运物资。”
“至于费用，则分为两部分，一部分是传送费用，大概是他们货物总价值的百分之五，另外一部分空间装备使用费，占据他们纯利润的百分之十五。”
“其中传送费归公，空间装备使用费用归您。”
“恩？”维林脸上露出疑惑之色，“这件事我怎么不知道。”
希伯来见状，想都没想，直接回答道：“我记得大哥早在几年前就将这个计划递交上去了，您不知道，那肯定是因为您偷懒。”
“砰——”
狠狠的敲了希伯来一下后，维林转头看向凯尔，开口说道：“将这小子给我挂到旗杆上去。”
凯尔见状，看着捂着脑袋的希伯来，低声道了一声歉后，随后提起他的衣领向北区军营飞去。
“公报私仇。”西莱斯特看着维林，不紧不慢的说道。
对于西莱斯特的嘲讽，维林直接当作没听见。

不得不说，将希伯来这小子放在这么远的地方太久了，导致这家伙心都野了，居然学会偷懒了。
再让这小子过一年舒坦日子，等立国后就把这小子调到王都来。
自己如今都已经是传奇了都还在努力修炼，这小子如今只是魂意高阶骑士，居然敢在偷懒，这像什么话，必须放在自己眼皮子地下，好好监督他要加倍努力才行。
另外，不能让这小子学奥兰多，不然他非得被气死。
另外一边，被悬挂在旗杆上的希伯来看着凯尔，愤愤不平的说道：“我虽然偷懒，但是主上不也偷懒吗？”
“其实主上最近挺勤快的。”凯尔深深看了一眼希伯来后，缓缓开口说道。
“你没骗我？”希伯来眼中带着不可置信，有些狐疑得询问道。
“没有。”
希伯来见状，低下头小声说道：“那好吧，是我错了。”
“这次你大概会待上三天，三天后我来找你。”
“恩。”
说完之后，凯尔转过身准备离去。
“等一下。”
凯尔闻言，重新转过身来看着希伯来。
“你手里有冒险故事书吗？”希伯来小声询问道。
content_en:
After going around in circles, the four of them arrived at the southern port.
Now at the observation deck, overlooking the sea below, there are no less than a thousand ships passing by, and each one is fully loaded with cargo.
"So many ships?"
"It's indeed quite a lot." Hebrew nodded and said.
"I asked why there are so many ships here." Welin turned to look at Hebrew and said helplessly.
"Because it's profitable, these people do it." Hebrew blinked, with an innocent expression on his face.
Seeing that the boy still didn't understand the meaning of his words, Weilin asked very straightforwardly: "Tell me the origin of the business prosperity here, who laid the foundation, and what scale it has reached now."
"I thought Lord, you were going to use this reason to praise me." Hebrew touched the back of his head and said slightly embarrassed.
After Verin glared at Hebra hard, he asked him to speak quickly.
If he hadn't known that this kid had a simple mind, he would have thought it was because he confiscated this kid's book, and he was pretending to be stupid here to pique himself.
"This is actually all the credit of Big Brother." Upon seeing this, Hebrew didn't dare to talk nonsense and explained obediently, "Because the fifth transfer station of the teleportation array is the Mermaid Kingdom of Hainas, Big Brother has opened a special channel, and our people carry space equipment as middlemen to help these merchants transfer supplies."
"As for the cost, it is divided into two parts. One part is the transmission fee, which is about 5% of the total value of their goods. The other part is the space equipment usage fee, which accounts for 15% of their net profit."
"The transmission fee belongs to the public, and the space equipment usage fee belongs to you."
"Huh?" A look of confusion appeared on Weilin's face, "Why don't I know about this?"
Seeing this, Hebrew didn't think twice and replied directly: "I remember that my eldest brother submitted this plan a few years ago. If you don't know, it must be because you are lazy."
"Bang——"
After knocking Hebrew hard, Verin turned to look at Kyle and said, "Hang this kid on the flagpole."
Upon seeing this, Kyle looked at Hebrew who was covering his head, apologized in a low voice, then picked up his collar and flew towards the North District Military Camp.
"Public revenge." Celeste looked at Verin and said calmly.
Verin pretended not to hear Celeste's taunt.
It has to be said that leaving the Hebrew boy so far away for so long has caused this guy to become wild-minded and actually learn to be lazy.
Let this kid live a comfortable life for another year, and then transfer this kid to the capital after the founding of the country.
He is already a legend now and is still practicing hard. This boy is just a high-level knight of the soul now, and he dares to be lazy. What kind of talk is this? He must put it under his nose and supervise him to redouble his efforts.
In addition, this kid cannot be allowed to imitate Orlando, otherwise he will be pissed to death.
On the other side, Hebrews who was hung on the flagpole looked at Kyle and said angrily: "Although I am lazy, isn't the Lord also lazy?"
"Actually, the Lord has been very diligent recently." Kyle said slowly after taking a deep look at Hebrew.
"You didn't lie to me?" Hebrew asked with disbelief in his eyes and some suspicion.
"No."
Seeing this, Hebrew lowered his head and whispered: "Well, I was wrong."
"You will stay for about three days this time, and I will come find you in three days."
"Yeah."
After saying that, Kyle turned around and prepared to leave.
"Wait a minute."
After hearing this, Kyle turned around and looked at Hebrew again.
"Do you have an adventure story book in your hand?" Hebrew asked in a low voice.
